from.place: Constant local models in the discrete Noetherian weak Serre input, pro-etale part

title: Pullback preserves finitely presented constant local models
statement: Let f:X→Y be any scheme morphism and R a commutative Noetherian ring. If an intrinsic module sheaf F on Y has finitely presented constant local models [def-sfb-proetale-fp-local-models], then its canonical constant-coefficient module inverse image f*F [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] on X has finitely presented constant local models. No weakly etale hypothesis on f or finiteness of R as a set is imposed.

source.place: Tag 093R, lemma-pullback-locally-constant; pro-etale base change of covering families

proof.text: Use the scalar comparison to regard F as a fixed-module-valued sheaf with finite constant local models. Evaluate its local-model condition at the terminal object Y. Refine the covering sieve by a covering family U_i→Y. The slice equivalence for each weakly etale U_i→Y identifies each slice constant model with the same constant sheaf on U_i.

Base change U_i→Y along f to a pro-etale covering Z_i→X. For each test V→X, pull this family back again to W_i=V×_X Z_i. These W_i cover V. Any arrow Q→V in their generated sieve factors through some W_i, and therefore gives a map p:Q→U_i over Y. The cartesian squares show Q→X→Y equals Q→U_i→Y.

Composition of inverse image identifies restriction of f*F to Q with inverse image along p of the constant model on U_i. Inverse image preserves that constant: its adjunction and the preservation of the terminal object by the base-change functor give the constant-sheaf comparison. Thus the same finite module is a model on Q. Finally the canonical coefficient map is invertible and the intrinsic/fixed pullback comparison transports this result back to the intrinsic module category; Noetherianity converts finite generation to finite presentation.

theorem proEtale_fp_localModels_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (F : proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y R))
    (hF : IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule F) :
    IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule
      (proEtaleConstantModulePullback f R F)
